2. कृत् cl. 6. P. कृन्तति, ep. also Ā. ˚ते and cl. 1. P. कर्तति (perf. चकर्त, 2nd fut. कर्त्स्यति or कर्तिष्यति, 1st fut. कर्तिता, Pāṇ. vii, 2, 57 ; Subj. कृन्तत्; aor. अकर्तीत्, Ved. 2. sg. अकृतस्), to cut, cut in pieces, cut off, divide, tear asunder, destroy, RV.; AV.; AitBr.; MBh. &c.: Caus. कर्तयति id., Pañcat. : Desid. चिकर्तिषति or चिकृत्सति, Pāṇ. vii, 2, 57;
कृत् [cf. κείρω, κάρσις; Lith. kertu inf. kirsti, ‘to cut’; Slav. korjū, ‘to split’; Lat. curtus, culter; Hib. ceartaighim, ‘I prune, trim, cut’; cuirc, ‘a knife’.]

3. कृत् cl. 7. P. कृणत्ति (impf. 3. pl. अकृन्तन्), to twist threads, spin, AV.; TS. ii; ŚBr. iii; MaitrS. = TāṇḍyaBr. (Nir. iii, 21); to wind (as a snake), AV. i, 27, 2 (pr. p. f. कृन्तती); to surround, encompass, attire, Dhātup. xxix, 10.

कृत्वस् ind. at the end of a numeral or numeral adjective, -fold, times (e.g. दश-कृत्वस्, ten times; बहु-क्˚, many times; पञ्च-क्˚, fivefold, Pāṇ. ii, 3, 64). In the Veda कृत्वस् is used as a separate word (e.g. भूरि क्˚, many times, RV. iii, 18, 4; पञ्च क्˚, TS. vi), but according to Pāṇ. v, 4, 17 and 20 (Vop. vii, 70) it is only an affix, and it is so used in classical Sanskṛt
it was originally an acc. pl. fr. कृतु, formed by the affix तु fr. √ 1. कृ (cf. also कृत् in सकृत्.)

a: कृत्वस् — ind. An affix added to numerals to denote ‘fold’ or ‘times’; e. g. अष्टकृत्वः eight times, eightfold; so दश˚, पंच˚ &c.
